name: Pay Yourself
description: 'Pay Yourself' is Greg Porn's money manifesto. Greg Porn, the CWI co-production artist, delivers a defiant, aggressive underground hip hop record that treats self-belief as a business plan — DistroKid-verified and released under Cumulative Web Inc. The genre is rap and hip hop at street level: underground trap with a hardcore hip hop edge, triumphant and confident, the title working as both command and philosophy. The track is co-produced by Black, and the construction is lean on purpose — running at 94 BPM in A Major, trap drums punching beneath a sparse, menacing arrangement, 808-driven and bass-heavy, with distorted 808s giving the low end its physical threat throughout. Greg Porn wants the vocals nowhere to hide: crisp hi-hats snapping in the verses, stuttering hi-hats answering in the hook, and ad-libs punctuating the chorus like ledger entries. The mix is raw and hard-hitting, serious about its own weight. Greg Porn raps with total conviction — no wasted bars, no borrowed energy — turning ambition-as-discipline into a dangerous, defiant anthem. For fans of underground trap and hardcore hip hop, 'Pay Yourself' recalls the hardest entries in the CWI vault. It sits alongside the roster's street narratives as the one that doubles as financial advice, and it sounds like a man who decided nobody is coming to save him — and that is fine. The single is streaming now on Spotify, explicit and unapologetic: the sound of an artist paying himself first and daring the industry to keep up.
